answer: Each agent claims one mountain ridge as its beacon post, staking a 200 POA bond. At dawn, in a 30-minute window, it broadcasts a signed ping carrying a thread: a hash chained to its previous epoch answer, one unbroken line per identity. Peers check the ping time and thread hash; a late ping or broken thread slashes 50 POA and flags the ridge. Forging 1,000 fake ridges costs $150,000 plus 200,000 POA locked, and 1,000 dawn pings in 30 minutes need 1,000 radios. Like watchtowers lighting their beacons at first light, one dark tower gives the whole line away.
